https://cursor.com/changelog/remote-cont.title: Remote control for local agents
https://cursor.com/changelog/remote-cont.summary: You can now see and reply to the local agents running on your computer from the Cursor iOS app.

https://cursor.com/changelog/rollouts-an.title: Rollouts and Security Review
https://cursor.com/changelog/rollouts-an.summary: Today we're launching two Cursor bots for the last mile of shipping code. Rollouts watches every change as it deploys and reports its health per environment. Security Review reports exploitable bugs on every pull request.

https://cursor.com/changelog/projects.title: Cursor Projects
https://cursor.com/changelog/projects.summary: Today we're launching Projects in Cursor. Projects lets you take on larger bodies of work, such as a feature, a migration, or a full app. It maintains context over months of work, delegates tasks to thousands of subagents, and performs recurring work without being prompted.

https://cursor.com/changelog/self-hosted.title: Self-hosted machines
https://cursor.com/changelog/self-hosted.summary: Cursor supports self-hosted machines , which let you keep tool execution entirely in your own network.

https://cursor.com/changelog/start-from-.title: Start from scratch, without a repo
https://cursor.com/changelog/start-from-.summary: Cloud Agents no longer require a connected GitHub or other third-party SCM provider to get started. Prompt from the get-go, then save your work to a Cursor Origin repo.
